name: Literature
overview: The world of literature is always changing and growing, turning words into stories, thoughts, and feelings that touch many parts of our lives. Literature encompasses diverse writing forms including books, poems, and essays, extending across traditional and digital platforms. Professionals blend creative imagination with linguistic proficiency to explore themes of identity, society, and human experience. The field offers exciting opportunities for those passionate about exploring and expressing the myriad facets of human experience.

topJobs.description: Individuals who craft original works of fiction or non-fiction across novels, short stories, and essays.
topJobs.globalSalary: ~$62,170 average (USA); varies significantly by success level
